svg.title: Turnstile continuation in the original tab
svg.desc: Observe one visible widget, click once using measured geometry, and verify the site receipt separately from verification clearance.
svg.text: Target: left + 28, vertical center; bounded jitter
Moved box, overlay or uncertain layout → leave pending
Native screen coordinates; no hard-coded toolbar height
C / Clearance is not an application receipt
No token values in tool output
Same Chrome profile and sessions; website decisions still apply.
